observations: A large black figure with bulbous body and thick limbs fills the center, marked by yellow bands at joints and waist against a teal background.
Two white asymmetric eyes with teal-green irises sit above a clenched rectangular mouth showing white teeth; red dot clusters appear on both cheeks.
A smaller black figure with X-shaped eyes and purple-pink accents perches on top, connected by curving black tendrils to a dangling round head bearing a crossbone symbol.
reading: The stacked figures read like a totem: a broad, stiff body anchors the composition while a smaller companion rides above, linked by loose, roaming tendrils. Yellow bands segment the dark mass into something almost mechanical, yet the mismatched eyes and red-dotted cheeks lend a vulnerable, flustered quality. Layered teal rectangles behind the figure create a shallow stage, boxing in a scene that feels both playful and uneasy.
contextAngle: Within the owned rawblocks subset, this piece sits between "nnxyz rawblocks #36" and "nnxyz rawblocks #38." Where #36 uses a single pale-faced figure on the same teal ground, #37 multiplies its characters and swaps open space for dense black fill, shifting from quiet to crowded.

connections.reason: Both share a teal background with nested rectangular frames and black-dominant figures, but #36's single round white face contrasts with #37's compound multi-headed body.
Both place a black face with prominent eyes against teal, but nnotb #120 dissolves its figure into frantic scribbled lines while #37 keeps solid, bounded shapes.

lookingQuestion: How do the curving tendrils connecting the three heads change your sense of whether these figures are separate beings or parts of one body?
ambiguities: The crossbone symbol on the dangling head could be a face or an emblem; the image does not resolve this clearly.
Whether the red dots on the cheeks are blush marks or something else is open to interpretation.
